steps.text: Start the operaung shaft lever, with the pivot pin up. on the end of the shaft with the flat on the shaft registering with the flat in the lever bore. Use a sleeve 10 press the lever tight against the bearing. On the heavy-duty shaft. use a rod to press the lever against the bearing until the lever is flush with the end of the shaft.
